title: Y2K: el temido cambio de milenio digital — "Y2K: the feared digital turn of the millennium"
notes: Colombia, Spanish: Señal Colombia's 'Anverso y reverso', 23 Nov 1999 — a Bogotá systems adviser explains the two-digit year on air six weeks before the century turns; period computer room, Compaq monitors, a blue globe, a second higher voice at the 98 s window. Fetched from RTVC's own Señal Memoria YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uNyk7J7G1JA); cut from a de-watermarked crop (crop=506:380:364:44) that removes the modern Señal Memoria bug and the modern burned-in caption bar
